evidence: Every launch assumption in tests/test.sh is stated to the agent. Entry: test.sh:68 refuses without /app/server.js and :111 runs `node "$APP_ENTRY"` from a cwd outside /app; instruction.md:5 'I start it with node /app/server.js' and integration.md:3 'from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location.' Port/probe: test.sh:48 probes http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then /; integration.md:3 'Listen on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (PORT is set to 3000 at launch), serve the workspace at / and answer GET /api/health promptly'. DB: test.sh:98-109 sets DB_PATH=/app/app.db or the /tmp/submission copy; integration.md:9 'If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app'. Deps: env -i NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (test.sh:106) with express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 installed globally in both environment/Dockerfile:9-12 and tests/Dockerfile:16-22 on Node 22; integration.md:5 states 'Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH' and 'I won't run an install or build step'. Symlinks: test.sh:72-83 refuses non-node_modules or escaping links; integration.md:11 states exactly that rule. Seed: artifacts include /assets (task.toml:2) and test.sh:88 only makes it readable; instruction.md:3/integration.md:7 name /assets/seed_data.json. Restart helper (test.sh:160-167) reuses the same env, matching integration.md:7,9 process-restart durability. No same-origin or sign-in assumption exists (app_context: no accounts). Runtime corroboration: test.sh and both Dockerfiles are byte-identical (LF-normalised) to v15, whose hosted Oracle run (kTaeUNx, hashes verified) reached reward 1.0 with app.log 'Colderwater ready on port 3000' and app-restart.log 'ready=1', using HOME=/tmp/submission, DB_PATH=/app/app.db; integration.md v15->v16 diff is wording only. No v16 configured-judge run exists, but the launch contract inputs are unchanged. Counterexample search: a conforming app that resolves files via __dirname, honours PORT/DB_PATH and uses only NODE_PATH or bundled /app/node_modules deps launches identically; a broken app that ignores DB_PATH still runs because DB_PATH equals the stated default /app/app.db when /app is writable (test.sh:87 chowns it), so no hidden contract penalises it. Minor unstated detail (no defect): the app runs as uid 65534 with a cleared env (only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH); test.sh neutralises this by chowning /app and its copy and setting a writable HOME, and the brief never invites reliance on other env vars or root-only resources, so no conforming app is plausibly failed by it. The lenient probe (HTTPError counts as ready, test.sh:51-52) is a gate-strength matter for other rows, not a contract mismatch.
